File No. D.91
REPORT
CENTRAL I. B. Section,
Date March 15, 1929.
Subject (in full) Interview with W. J. Tschedanoff.
Made by D. S. Ovsianikoff. Forwarded by Tho Robertson C.D.I
At 9.30 a.m. March 14 I interviewed Mr. W. J.
Tschedanoff in the office of the Rickmers Line, 6 The Bund,
where he informed me that several days ago he was approached
by a Russian named Koulchitsky, residing at 381 Avenue Joffre,
who requested his assistance in buying for a certain firm
a quantity of Scythes stored in the China Merchants Steam
Navigation Company's godown.
These scythes, according to Tschedanoff, were imported
in 1920 by the Rickmers' Line from Germany to be sent to
Siberia via Shanghai, but owing to Civil War in Siberia
they were temporarily stored in the godowns of the China
Merchants' Steams Navigation Company and later the Rickmers
Line refused to take delivery of them. Mr. Tschedanoff
further stated that he does not know on whose behalf
Koulchitsky was acting as the latter did not tell him the
particulars of the transaction.
At 9.15 a.m. March 15 I communicated with Mr.
Koulchitsky, who informed me that he had now offered the
scythes for sale to Mr. M.A. Lourie, Commercial Agent of
the local Branch of the Chinese Eastern Railway who in turn
offered them to a certain local Soviet commercial enterprise
and the matter is now under consideration. It is said that
in the event of the scythes being purchased by Soviet
interests they will be forwarded to U.S.S.R. The purchase
price asked is 20c per scythe and so far no decision has been
reached as to their disposal.
V. Ovsianikoff
D. S.
A. Information
Stevens
apcl.
HR. 3/16 29
A/D.C.I.

报告
中央情报股，
日期 1929年3月15日。
主题（全称）与 W. J. Tschedanoff 的面谈。
由 D. S. Ovsianikoff 制作。经 Tho Robertson C.D.I 转呈
3月14日上午9时30分，我在外滩6号瑞克梅尔轮船公司（Rickmers Line）办公室会见了 W. J. Tschedanoff 先生，他告知我，几天前有一位居住在霞飞路381号的俄国人 Koulchitsky 找他，请求他协助某商行购买存放在招商局栈房的一批镰刀。
据 Tschedanoff 称，这些镰刀是瑞克梅尔轮船公司于1920年从德国进口，计划经上海运往西伯利亚，但由于西伯利亚内战，暂时储存在招商局轮船公司的栈房内，后来瑞克梅尔轮船公司拒绝提货。Tschedanoff 先生进一步表示，他不知道 Koulchitsky 是代表谁行事，因为后者并未向他透露交易的具体细节。
3月15日上午9时15分，我与 Koulchitsky 先生取得联系，他告知我，他现已向中东铁路本地分支机构的商务代理 M.A. Lourie 先生报价出售这批镰刀，而 Lourie 先生又将其转报给当地某苏维埃商业企业，目前此事正在审议中。据说，如果苏维埃方面购买这批镰刀，它们将被运往苏联。要求的购买价格为每把镰刀20美分，截至目前，尚未就其处置作出决定。
V. Ovsianikoff
D. S.
A. 情报
Stevens

Dear Sir,
Herewith I beg to inform you that I am not in
possession of any documents regarding the cargo in question
stated in my letter of 19th inst., and yours of yesterday's
date.

I have a buyer for the whole lot and would be
much obliged if you kindly let me know the quantity of the
scythes the price and stipulate the time when I may see the
cases, suppose you intend to sell the cargo.

Thanking you in anticipation, I am, Dear Sir,
Yours faithfully,

(Sd) W.J.Tschedanoff.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D.: 91
Central L.S. Section.
Date ....................
Date March 11th 1930）

Subject (in full) W.J. Tschedanoff.

Made by D. G. Ovsiannikoff Forwarded by H. Swain A.C. Mc

Sir,

With reference to your file, inquiries go to show that Mr. Vasil, Pavlovitch Tschedanoff, Russian, 50 years of age, married to German lady resides at 741 Avenue Joffre.

Mr. and Mrs. V.J. Tschedanoff arrived in Shanghai from Russia eight years ago and now. After Mr. V.J. Tschedanoff obtained employment in the Machinery and Optic Department of the Carlo Ian Company, Nanking Road. Mr. V.J. Tschedanoff was unemployed for sometime and a few years ago joined the local shipping office of the Rickmers Line, 5 The Bund, as a book-keeper.

It appears that Mr. V.J. Tschedanoff is friendly with Mr. Karl Oldorp, Manager of the local office of the Rickmers Line, who is also a representative of several important metal foundries and factories in Germany and who is the sole supplier of various metals for the Chinese Eastern Railway.

In view of the fact that Mr. W.J. Tschedanoff who has no money, is merely an employee and is not in a position to buy such a large quantity of scythes, it is presumed that he was instructed by Mr. Karl Oldorp to approach the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company with the offer on behalf of the German Metal factories.

There is nothing in Police records concerning him.

HR. 1137
V. Ovsiannikoff
D. S.
A/Ph. I.
11/3/30

It is probable that the parties, on whose behalf Tschedanoff is acting, intend to sell the scythes for farming. I, therefore, suggest that Tschedanoff be asked to give an explanation of the purpose for which they are required.
JLB

主题（全称）W.J. Tschedanoff。

由 D. G. Ovsiannikoff 制作，经 H. Swain A.C. Mc 转呈

先生，

关于贵处卷宗，调查显示，Vasil Pavlovitch Tschedanoff 先生，俄国人，50岁，娶德国女子为妻，居住于霞飞路741号。

V.J. Tschedanoff 夫妇于八年前从俄国抵达上海。V.J. Tschedanoff 先生曾在南京路 Carlo Ian 公司（音译）的机械与光学部任职。V.J. Tschedanoff 先生曾失业一段时间，几年前加入位于外滩5号的瑞克梅尔轮船公司本地航运办事处，担任簿记员。

看来 V.J. Tschedanoff 先生与瑞克梅尔轮船公司本地办事处经理 Karl Oldorp 先生关系友好，后者也是德国几家重要金属铸造厂和工厂的代表，并且是中东铁路各种金属的唯一供应商。

鉴于 W.J. Tschedanoff 先生身无分文，仅是一名雇员，无力购买如此大量的镰刀，推测他是受 Karl Oldorp 先生指示，代表德国金属工厂向招商局轮船公司提出报价。

警方档案中没有任何关于他的记录。

HR. 1137
V. Ovsiannikoff
D. S.
A/Ph. I.
30年3月11日

Tschedanoff 所代表的各方可能打算将这些镰刀作为农具出售。因此，我建议要求 Tschedanoff 说明需要这些镰刀的用途。
JLB
